From the owner
You’ve decided to remodel the bathroom. Now comes the next question: how do you choose ALL the things? Cabinets, shower tile, flooring, paint… each decision can feel manageable on its own. Figuring out how they’ll look together is where it gets tricky! For this Wyatt Farms bathroom in Blacksburg, the homeowners worked with our design partners at Reico Kitchen & Bath, DeHart Tile Co., and independent paint consultant Jamie Seela. Together, those choices became a room that feels like theirs: from the Blue Onyx waterfall tile to the coordinating blue vanity and lighter flooring. In our newest blog post, we’re sharing how that process works and why you don’t need to have every answer before getting started: https://www.renodb.com/blog/bathroom-remodel-design-process-blacksburg
